description: This Java class implements a fake backend for a store, managing public keys for users, verifying transactions via digital signatures, and enrolling new users with their public keys. It is part of an Android project related to asymmetric fingerprint dialogs.

classes.name: StoreBackendImpl
classes.description: A fake backend implementation of the StoreBackend interface, managing user public keys and verifying transactions.

methods.name: verify (Transaction, byte[])
methods.description: Verifies a transaction using its signature and public key, preventing replay attacks.

methods.name: verify (Transaction, String)
methods.description: A simplification that always returns true, assuming password validation.

methods.name: enroll
methods.description: Enrolls a user by associating their userId with their public key.
